name: preview-card-4v
title: Preview Card 4v: Dog-ear on the preview
author: tony <tony@spaceman.sh>
description: A catalogue card for showing a live component preview. The outer card stays fully rounded. The fold sits on the inner preview's corner and matches its 10px radius.
docs: Every preview card design exports the same `PreviewCard` component, so you can switch designs by changing the import path. Pass the live preview as children.
